title: Mission Briefing, Selection, Objectives, and Rewards
description:
Purpose: Drive mission selection in Command Hall, track objectives on HUD/wrist, support optional modifiers, and debrief with rewards and unlocks.

Behaviour:
- Interaction: In command_hall, when the player approaches the star_map_prop dais and presses A (Right), open a ring-projected mission panel listing sectors. Left/Right UI selection handled by hud_wrist_menu; this mechanic provides mission data and accepts "accept" commands.
- Mission data: Loads mission nodes with fields: id, name, summary, difficulty, modifiers (e.g., reduced-intensity flight). Presents previews with holograms from mission_console_hologram.
- Accepting a mission: On accept, autosave (save_load_system), set active_mission, push objective list to HUD (ring_ui_hud_assets) and wrist menu (hud_wrist_menu). Telemetry: emit "mission.accepted".
- Objectives: Provide an objective tracker component CObjectiveState on the player with current and completed lists. Expose API to update objectives by tag (e.g., enemies_defeated, civilians_rescued). Integrate with civilian_rescue_mechanic and portal_travel_mechanic.
- Completion/failure: On objective completion, show debrief panel: rewards (willpower mastery points), unlocks (construct categories), partial progress rewards supported. Autosave on completion and reward distribution.
- Optional comfort variants: if selected, annotate flight_mode_mechanic with reduced max speeds and increased horizon lock for that mission.

Quest 3 bindings (params_json):
- params.value("interact_button", "A_right")

Components read/write:
- Reads CMechanicBinding, scene triggers near star_map_prop and mission_console_hologram.
- Writes CMissionState{ active:bool, mission_id, objectives }, CObjectiveState entries; updates CSavedProfile (progression_mastery_system) and save via save_load_system.

Acceptance hooks:
- test_mission_select_flow: A near Star Map opens preview; accept sets objectives to HUD/wrist.

Integration points:
- save_load_system: autosaves on accept/complete.
- progression_mastery_system: awards mastery points on completion.
- hud_wrist_menu: displays Mission panel and current objectives.

Assets/scenes: command_hall (selection), all mission scenes (objective tracking).
